services.desc: NST is excited to welcome your child to our Summer 2026 Northshore Youth Tennis Camp! Each week, activities and games will adhere to a certain theme where campers will build their sportsmanship skills as well as increase their personal repertoire of individual tennis abilities. These activities are meant to both comfortably challenge campers and foster an enjoyment for the game of tennis. Safety is our top priority as well as inclusivity. We are looking forward to an amazing summer! How to Drop Off (Camp Begins at 9:00): Please sign your child in to camp each day at the check-in station where a Tennis Camp staff member will meet you. blurb: We are a non-profit tennis club located in Salem, MA, serving the sports community of the Boston area North Shore. Everyone is welcome. We offer 2 indoor tru-bounce surfaced courts, 2 outdoor Har-Tru courts, Locker Rooms, Cable TV & WiFi, Racquet repairs & stringing, Youth and Adult Lessons, Summer Camps and Pickleball. From the beginner to the seasoned player, there is something for everyone at Northshore Tennis.
